priority_rule: Accepted LIVE capture + official broker/exchange/issuer/regulator sources; current broker pages are not retroactively promoted to 2022-2026 point-in-time truth.

sources.title: A home for commodity traders
facts: Pepperstone commodity cash CFDs are described as cash products derived from front-month futures.
Cash contracts are described as indefinite with continuous charting and no user contract roll.
Overnight funding applies to cash commodity positions.
sources.limitation: Does not publish the exact 2022-2026 underlying-contract switch timetable, roll-effective timestamps, LP-specific transition rule, or adjustment series required by frozen C008.

sources.title: How our spot crude price is calculated
facts: Pepperstone states that its liquidity provider creates a cash US crude price from the front-month or active crude future under normal market conditions.
Cash and futures prices converge toward expiry through interest/time adjustments.
Pepperstone explicitly warns that the normal pricing logic can change in disorderly underlying-market conditions.
sources.limitation: No immutable per-roll historical contract IDs/effective timestamps/adjustment values for 2022-2026.

sources.title: How much does commodity CFD trading cost?
facts: Spot commodity markets and -F forward CFDs are separate product families.
Published spread statistics are recent-period statistics, not a 2022-2026 historical path.
Forward CFDs are automatically rolled; this does not establish SpotCrude's historical cash-series construction.
sources.limitation: Recent minimum/average spreads cannot be promoted to VERIFIED historical Discovery costs or an upper conservative bound.

sources.title: Trading accounts
facts: Overnight funding applies to CFDs held past the daily cutoff.
Latest swap rates are shown on trading platforms.
Pepperstone states swap rates are subject to change with market volatility.
Slippage can occur when markets move quickly or gap.
sources.limitation: Does not establish historical AUDJPY financing rates/effective timestamps or bounded historical slippage.

sources.title: Trading costs and fees
facts: Current US share/ETF CFD commission is published as 0.02 USD per share with no minimum.
Pepperstone states swap rates may change daily and updates take effect immediately.
The online funding calculator is indicative and actual charges may differ.
sources.limitation: Current commissions/formulas and indicative rates do not prove exact 2022-2026 costs.

sources.title: How does Pepperstone handle dividends and corporate actions?
facts: Share/index CFD positions held past ex-dividend are cash-adjusted.
Longs are credited and shorts debited.
Pepperstone states the cash adjustment may differ from the exact underlying dividend due to market conditions and withholding tax.
Corporate actions include stock splits and Pepperstone passes liquidity-provider adjustments through.
sources.limitation: Does not provide the exact historical CFD dividend/corporate-action adjustment ledger for the accepted account/products.

sources.title: Trading Hours During Market Times
facts: Current server time follows GMT+3 during US daylight saving and GMT+2 otherwise.
Current product tables distinguish SpotCrude, US500, NAS100 and standard USA Shares sessions.
Pepperstone states hours are subject to seasonal and market changes.
sources.limitation: Current schedules/holiday table cannot be backfilled as exact historical Pepperstone session truth for 2022-2026.

global_non_promotion_rules: Current Pepperstone schedules, spreads, commissions, swap snapshots and ExpectedMargin are not historical 2022-2026 truth.
Issuer dividends/splits/ticker changes establish underlying corporate events only; they do not manufacture broker-specific CFD cash adjustments.
No current/recent average spread statistic is an upper historical bound.
No unspecified slippage magnitude is converted into a finite conservative bound without evidence.
